title: Silicone Cable Holder Clips
summary: Adhesive silicone clips that hold charging cables on a desk or nightstand. No magnets.
lead: Keep a charging cable on the desk instead of on the floor. Soft silicone, no magnets.
care: Wipe clean. Adhesive holds best on a dry, smooth surface. Removing a clip may leave residue.
ship: 1–2 business days to process. Tracked international parcel from China.
bodyHtml:
Adhesive silicone clips that hold charging cables on a desk or nightstand. No magnets.

A light first-order item. Stick the pad to a dry, smooth surface, then press the cable into the clip.

title: Drawer Organizer
summary: Open bins for sorting a shallow drawer. Use in a desk, vanity, or kitchen drawer.
lead: Open bins for a shallow drawer — desk, vanity, or kitchen.
care: Wipe clean. Not a cosmetic kit.
ship: 1–2 business days to process. Tracked international parcel from China.
bodyHtml:
Open bins for sorting a shallow drawer. Use in a desk, vanity, or kitchen drawer.

This is a drawer organizer, not a cosmetic kit. Arrange the pieces to fit the drawer you have.

title: Bamboo Drawer Divider
summary: Adjustable bamboo dividers that expand to split a drawer into sections.
lead: Expand the slats to split one drawer into sections. Measure the drawer first.
care: Wipe clean. Measure your drawer before ordering.
ship: 1–2 business days to process. Tracked international parcel from China.
bodyHtml:
Adjustable bamboo dividers that expand to split a drawer into sections.

Measure the inside width of the drawer before you order. Wipe clean; do not soak.

title: Kitchen Sink Caddy
summary: A caddy that holds a sponge and brush beside the sink. Drain holes let water run off. No soap is included.
lead: Holds a sponge and brush beside the sink. Drain holes let water run off.
inbox: 1 sink caddy. No soap or brush included.

bodyHtml:
A caddy that holds a sponge and brush beside the sink. Drain holes let water run off.

No soap or liquid is included. Rinse and air-dry after use.
